title: xDrip+ gets "zero slope calibration"  when calibrating through the add treatment dialog
body: This starting happening the other day. I am using a Nexus 6P with android 7.1.1. Whenever I add a BG through the add treatment dialog, I get the "got zero slope calibration" error. Any ideas what could be causing this,

comments.body:
Next time you get this can you try adding a BG via the `Add Calibration` menu item and let me know if it gives the same error?

Thanks.

I've managed to reproduce this bug in testing and identified the code which caused it and I think eliminated it now. Its down to a concurrency issue which is why it sometimes happens and mostly doesn't. The fix will be in the next nightly. Please let me know if you ever see it again after that.
